verdict.rationale: Maritime is a cloud platform for hosting AI agents, not an agent itself, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence documents only adjacent agent-facing surfaces: an agent-operable CLI with --json output, a REST API, and a paste-in prompt for assistants. None of the evidence mentions an official MCP server or MCP endpoint, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
